patch_description: Rank screened moves first by their effect on the parent’s positive-price links, then by surrogate-energy change. A two-switch that removes a bottleneck link without adding another is more promising for reducing the LP objective than an energy-favored move that leaves the bottlenecks untouched. Keeping energy as the secondary criterion retains the existing pool-specific guidance, while the unchanged batch size limits the extra LP-call cost. Pass the already-computed LP detail into screening at both call sites.
